use default

overlap(left: string, right: string) -> int is
    let longest = System.Math.min(left.length, right.length)
    let size mut = longest

    while size > 0 /\ !left.ends_with(right[0..size]) do
        size = size - 1
    od

    return size
si

shortest_superstring(sequences: string[]) -> string is
    let pieces = LIST[string]()

    for sequence in sequences do
        if !(pieces |> any(p => p.contains(sequence))) then
            pieces.remove_all(p => sequence.contains(p))
            pieces.add(sequence)
        fi
    od

    while pieces.count > 1 do
        let best mut = (left = 0, right = 1, shared = -1)

        for i in 0..pieces.count do
            for j in 0..pieces.count do
                if i != j then
                    let shared = overlap(pieces[i], pieces[j])

                    if shared > best.shared then
                        best = (i, j, shared)
                    fi
                fi
            od
        od

        let tail = pieces[best.right][best.shared..<0]
        let merged = "{pieces[best.left]}{tail}"

        pieces[best.left] = merged
        pieces.remove_at(best.right)
    od

    return pieces[0]
si

report(sequences: string[]) is
    let result = shortest_superstring(sequences)

    write_line("shortest common superstring: {result}")
    write_line("  {result.length} bases")

    for base in ['A', 'C', 'G', 'T', 'U'] do
        let count = result |> filter(c => c == base) |> count()

        if count > 0 then
            write_line("  {base}: {count}")
        fi
    od

    write_line("")
si
